The '''Tynquay Sector Forces''' was a military organization that operated in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]].

==History==
The organization was active for several decades prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] officer [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] served in it for just as long, gaining experience to make him an authority on military tactics and diplomacy.
